author: GamingBolt
description:
Fatal Frame 2: Crimson Butterfly Remake tries to accomplish many things while bringing the classic title to current-gen platforms. And while the effort is largely successful, it might not be everybody's cup of tea in the way its developers probably hope. 

The combat system, and enemy aggression in particular, is a major drawback especially in the early hours of the experience, while things don't get better even as you unlock more powerful upgrades for the Camera Obscura. 

The game's performance is another sore spot, although it's far easier to overlook that in the big picture. And yet, the story, revamped visuals, and the general vibe of Minakami Village kept us coming back for more during our time with it.
title: Fatal Frame 2 Crimson Butterfly Remake - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
There are some games that are conceptually perfect, at which point, once they exist, the only thing standing in the way of them and impeccable perfection is their execution of their pitch. Pokopia is the rare game that has a perfect concept, and then nearly pitch-perfect execution and follow-through on that concept. It is, very literally, everything you’d expect and want a Pokemon life sim game to be, and a lot more you’d never even known you wanted. 

Charming, bursting to the seams with personality, and dangerously addictive to near lethal levels, Pokemon Pokopia is arguably the best Pokemon spin-off of all time, and will go down as one of the early defining games of the Nintendo Switch 2 library.
title: Pokémon Pokopia Review - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
The RE Engine is more than just a pretty face capable of powering graphically intensive games. It's a powerhouse that lets those games live up to their potential, working behind the scenes with fascinating portability. 
It transcends the boundaries of genres, molding itself to each title's unique requirements with enough ease to enable teams achieve their creative visions with nary a hiccup. 

But how does it manage this? That's what this one is about, as we dive into the science behind the magic of how the RE Engine has made a name for itself as a reliable tool that's only getting better with each game that it's a part of.
title: Is RE Engine The Defining Game Engine of This Generation?

author: GamingBolt
description:
It may be less than two weeks away, but the wait for Crimson Desert is just becoming unnerving at this point. However, thanks to the latest round of previews, there is a bunch of new information to sort through. 

Much of this focuses on hands-on time that various publications and content creators have had within the first five or so hours, and it's incredible just how much there is, on top of everything that the development team has already revealed. So let's dive into it all, starting with...
title: Crimson Desert - 15 More Major Features You Probably Overlooked
